version_history.reason: Initial contract-only freeze before behavior outcomes

scope_boundaries: The evaluated product is the current Stage source snapshot, not PROD or a remote deployment inferred from local code.
Source readiness and local adapters do not prove actual OAuth host, external payment/email delivery, production activation, or owner UAT.
Active monthly/annual migration is deliberately unavailable under D060 clarification; fail-closed is the accepted requirement, not missing implementation.
Apple, teams/shared ownership, public/Live activation, scheduled Sending activation, automatic tax/FX, destructive purge and C5K tenancy rewrite are out of scope.

Actual host lifecycle, annual/3DS/due-failure/grace, scheduled invocation, matched-host capacity and broader recovery remain required evidence gaps where selected; they are UNKNOWN without evidence, not code defects merely because credentials or policy are unavailable.
No adopted purge period/unattended backup cadence/RPO/RTO is invented; policy-pending mechanism/runbooks can be evaluated while irreversible action remains excluded.
Agent governance is operational authority, excluded as the object of product evaluation.

source_conflicts.resolution: The old blanket Void/releases-time rule is superseded for new PH3 published claims by permanent claims; retain only historical Void semantics.

Historical no-public-signup/no-automatic-issuance statements describe earlier increments; current source supports separately gated registration and new explicitly scoped reviewed terminal powers, without hosted broad admission.
D070 moves clock into fourth metric without visible timezone claim, superseding earlier visible Time zone metric wording.

Application follows explicit Monday-Sunday/exact-minute/1200 cap/no automatic gross-up rules, not contradictory unsigned-draft clauses; original commercial acceptance cannot be certified from source notes alone.
D084 current rounded squares/solid future fills supersede historical D081 hourglass report and D083 dashed fills; historical sections are not current visual contract.
Dated historical processing statements are superseded by current notice/session/export/closure sections; no legal worldwide compliance finding is inferred.
